expectationSources: primary CPU, C64, and ACME facts

runtime.irqPolicy: stock cooperative KERNAL IRQ remains enabled during the game loop
runtime.nmiPolicy: stock KERNAL RESTORE/NMI path remains mapped and owned by the profile

behaviorObligations.name: sprite-ownership
behaviorObligations.fact: sprite 0 is the player, sprites 1 through 6 map to enemy indexes 0 through 5, and sprite 7 is the projectile or explosion

behaviorObligations.name: player-input
behaviorObligations.fact: joystick port 2 is read once per update; opposing directions do not move; horizontal movement is clamped to 48 through 296

behaviorObligations.name: fire-edge
behaviorObligations.fact: a new projectile at player x and y 199 requires an idle slot and a rising fire edge

behaviorObligations.name: formation
behaviorObligations.fact: live enemies move one pixel each eighth playing update or reverse and descend eight pixels at the next live outer-edge violation; animation toggles on either action

behaviorObligations.name: collision
behaviorObligations.fact: the inclusive two-by-eight projectile rectangle is tested against live 24-by-21 enemy rectangles in ascending array order and resolves at most one hit

behaviorObligations.name: explosion
behaviorObligations.fact: a hit immediately publishes explosion frame 1, the next update publishes frame 2, and the following update makes slot 7 idle

behaviorObligations.name: win-loss
behaviorObligations.fact: zero live enemies wins before loss is considered; any live enemy y of 200 or more loses; terminal state freezes player and formation

behaviorObligations.name: terminal-exit
behaviorObligations.fact: after a visible terminal frame and an idle slot, fire must be observed released and then newly pressed before restoration and RTS to BASIC

behaviorObligations.name: publication-order
behaviorObligations.fact: all eight slots publish enable, position including shared x-msb ownership, pointer, and color in slot order, followed by one border write

behaviorObligations.name: startup-return
behaviorObligations.fact: the 12-byte BASIC auto-start enters at $080d; CPU registers, status and stack plus every changed VIC, CIA2, screen-pointer, and 6510-port field are restored before RTS

storage.hardwareStackCooperativeSystemPeakReason: the selected KERNAL IRQ and RESTORE/NMI paths are profile-owned and require separate revision-pinned whole-route measurement

cycles.reason: the complete value must include final branch placement, path choices, page effects, VIC bus denial, and cooperative KERNAL interrupt work; source-level instruction counting is not substituted

requiredDimensions: code, data, asset, and padding bytes
zero-page, static RAM, and hardware-stack use
RAM and MMIO traffic count and order
named path and complete fixed-trace cycles
